blocks.task_summary: Sketch the graph of f(x) = e^x - 3x - 4 on the domain -4 <= x <= 3, showing roots, y-intercept, local minimum, and endpoints with approximate accuracy.
method_path: Locate roots approximately: one root in (-2, -1) and one in (2, 3)
Find local minimum near x in (0.5, 1.5) with y in (-5, -4)
Evaluate endpoints at x = -4 and x = 3
Sketch smooth curve through all key features

evidence.basis: A1A1A1: A1 for approximately correct roots in -2<x<-1 and 2<x<3; A1 for y-intercept in -3.5<y<-2.5 and local minimum in 0.5<x<1.5, -5<y<-4; A1 for approximately correct endpoints.

blocks.task_summary: Find horizontal stretch factor k and vertical translation c that transform f(x)=e^x-3x-4 into g(x)=e^{2x}-6x-7.
method_path: Apply horizontal stretch x->x/k to f: f(x/k)=e^{x/k}-3(x/k)-4
Match linear and constant: -3x/(1/2)-4+c=-6x-7 gives c=-3

evidence.basis: A1 for k=1/2; A1 for c=-3 (accept translate/shift 3 units down).
